summary: Partner Kios Order Pricing Feature - Complete testing of warehouse-based pricing fix. Fixed critical backend bug (wh_id undefined at line 1003). All backend API tests (5/5) passed. Frontend UI tests verified correct price display based on warehouse type: dus warehouses show box_price, satuan warehouses show unit price. Per-item warehouse selector in cart working correctly - price updates when changing warehouse.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Partner Orders warehouse/pricing feature fully functional: 1) When default warehouse is 'Gudang Utama' or 'Gudang Lainnya' (unit=dus), product prices display box_price (e.g., ABACEL 1L = Rp 1,000,000/dus). 2) When default warehouse is 'Gudang Toko' (unit=satuan), product prices display unit price (e.g., ABACEL 1L = Rp 110,000/satuan). 3) Each cart item has its own warehouse selector that can be changed independently. 4) Changing cart item warehouse updates price and subtotal automatically. 5) Stock is deducted from each item's warehouse_id, not a global warehouse. Backend fixed: 'wh_id' undefined variable corrected to 'default_wh_id'.
